subject: Handoff: NovaForge org setup & API access
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@novaforge.com>, Samir Chaudhry <samir@novaforge.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Handoff: NovaForge org setup & API access

Hi Elena / Samir —

Congrats on finalizing the order — excited to get NovaForge fully onboarded. I want to introduce Jonas (Customer Success lead) who will run the implementation, and Monica who will be the implementation engineer assigned to your account. Laura will support change management and training.

High-level goals for the handoff call:
- Create NovaForge organization and initial projects in Redwood
- Provision API keys and role scaffolding for service accounts and engineers
- Confirm SSO & IP allowlist requirements
- Agree on a 2-week pilot (test project) and go-live criteria

Action items for kickoff (can be handled before the call):
1) Please confirm the primary admin user email for invites (we'll send the initial org invites).
2) Confirm whether you prefer API keys per project or a single global service key.
3) Share any IP ranges to allow and SAML IdP metadata (if SSO).

Attaching the signed order form and a short scope doc — Jonas will propose a 30–45 minute kickoff tomorrow.

Attachments: NovaForge_OrderForm_signed.pdf, Onboarding_Scope_NovaForge.xlsx

Thanks,
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

From: Elena Park <elena@novaforge.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Samir Chaudhry <samir@novaforge.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handoff: NovaForge org setup & API access

Thanks Rishi — excited to get started. A few quick answers before the kickoff: 
- Primary admin: elena@novaforge.com (Elena) — please invite me as Org Admin.
- API key approach: for the pilot we'd prefer a single service key scoped to the test project; we'll evaluate finer-grained keys post-pilot.
- SSO: We're planning to use Okta. I can share the metadata XML and our IdP SSO URL; attaching a redacted metadata file in a follow-up.
- IP allowlist: we'll provide ranges from our infra team but not required for pilot.

Also: we have a security questionnaire pending — if the CS team can share SOC2 evidence/attestation pointers, that would help procurement.

Elena
Head of AI Infrastructure | NovaForge

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handoff: NovaForge org setup & API access

Perfect — thanks for the quick replies, Elena. I've uploaded the signed order to your folder and attached it here for reference. Procurement asked about SOC2 evidence — Jonas / Laura, can someone drop the standard SOC2 attestation link into the kickoff materials?

Attachments: NovaForge_OrderForm_signed.pdf, Onboarding_Scope_NovaForge.xlsx

Rishi

To: Elena Park <elena@novaforge.com>, Samir Chaudhry <samir@novaforge.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Handoff: NovaForge org setup & API access

Hi Elena / Samir —

Thanks for the details — I'll own the implementation. Below is our proposed onboarding plan and checklist for the pilot. Please review and flag anything missing: 

Kickoff (Day 0 — 30–45m):
- Introductions, scope confirmation, success criteria, timelines
- Confirm admin user and invite targets

Day 1 (Org & Project creation):
- Create NovaForge org in Redwood and two projects: "nf-pilot" (test) and "nf-prod" (reserved)
- Create RBAC roles: Org Admin, Project Admin, Developer, ReadOnly
- Issue a single scoped API key for nf-pilot service account as requested

Day 2–5 (Integrations & Security):
- Send SAML metadata instructions and implement Okta SSO for test users (we'll provide step-by-step guide)
- Configure IP allowlist for pilot if you provide ranges
- Share SOC2 attestation link and relevant security docs

Week 2 (Pilot testing):
- Run smoke tests with small traffic pattern; monitor latencies and token usage
- Iterate on key scoping / rate limits if needed

Go-live criteria:
- Test project passes smoke tests for 48 hours with acceptable latencies
- Key usage patterns understood and role mappings verified

Pre-kickoff asks (please reply here or attach to the hubspot ticket):
- Confirm: admin invite email (Elena confirmed elena@novaforge.com)
- Preferred kickoff windows (options US-PST: Tue 3/30 10:00–11:00 or Wed 3/31 09:00–09:45)
- Any extra compliance evidence requests (beyond SOC2)

Attachments included: RI_Onboarding_Checklist_v1.xlsx (playbook + action tracker). For convenience, here's the implementation playbook link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bOnboardingPlaybook

I'll schedule the kickoff for Tue 3/30 10:00 PST unless you prefer the alternate slot. Monica will be on the call to take notes and start project provisioning.

Thanks — looking forward to working together.

Jonas Weber
Customer Success Lead | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai

From: Elena Park <elena@novaforge.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handoff: NovaForge org setup & API access

Thanks Jonas — Tue 3/30 at 10:00 PST works for the kickoff. Confirming:
- Admin invite: elena@novaforge.com
- We will use a single scoped key for nf-pilot initially
- I'll upload Okta metadata and the IP ranges to the hubspot ticket this afternoon
- Procurement: SOC2 attestation link would be great (we're collecting docs this week)

See you on the call — please include a calendar invite with a dial-in and a short agenda.

Best,
Elena
Head of AI Infrastructure | NovaForge
